Full job description

Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Shopify Website Backend Specialist to join our innovative e-commerce team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing the backend infrastructure of Clothing Brand Shopify stores to ensure seamless functionality, robust performance, and scalable growth. Your expertise will drive the integration of various APIs, manage database systems, and implement secure, efficient web services that enhance the overall shopping experience. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of web development, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver outstanding online retail solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Shopify backend functionalities using technologies such as RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and custom app integrations to support complex e-commerce operations.
  • Design and optimize database schemas utilizing PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB to ensure fast data retrieval and reliable storage solutions.
  • Implement and manage web services using SOAP, WCF, and other protocols to facilitate communication between third-party systems and internal platforms.
  • Collaborate with front-end developers to integrate Angular, React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript into cohesive user interfaces that enhance user engagement.
  • Automate deployment processes through CI/CD pipelines utilizing GitHub, TFS, Azure DevOps, or SVN to streamline updates and ensure continuous improvement.
  • Troubleshoot and debug backend issues with tools like Visual Studio, Eclipse, or Linux command-line interfaces while adhering to SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) best practices.
  • Ensure security compliance by implementing authentication protocols and managing API security measures across cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure.

Experience

  • Proven experience in web development with a focus on e-commerce platforms like Shopify or similar CMS solutions.
  • Strong proficiency in C#,.NET Framework/.NET Core, Java, Python, PHP, or Ruby on Rails for application development.
  • Extensive knowledge of database design and management using SQL (T-SQL), PostgreSQL, MySQL, or NoSQL databases like MongoDB.
  • Hands-on experience working with RESTful APIs, SOAP web services, XML/JSON data formats for seamless system integrations.
  • Familiarity with microservices architecture and multithreading concepts to build scalable backend systems.
  • Experience with version control systems such as GitHub, SVN, or TFS along with agile methodologies like Scrum or Kanban.
  • Ability to perform unit testing and debugging effectively while maintaining high code quality standards using tools like Visual Studio or Eclipse.

Join us if you’re passionate about building robust backend solutions that power innovative e-commerce experiences! We value proactive problem solvers who thrive in collaborative environments—ready to make a significant impact in the world of online retail technology!

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Work Location: Remote
